parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description:
The domain name of the website service.
> The domain name must have a website service forwarding rule configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the hour or half hour.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the hour or half hour.
